learning.title: Prove lease, interruption and stale-producer states with a fake executable at zero model cost
learning.trigger: A proof needs SIGSTOP, SIGKILL, lost-lease, timeout or quota states from a harness run.
learning.mistake: Spent funded model runs on states that do not need inference, and missed that the harness spawns the executable with a cleared environment so env knobs never reach a fake.
learning.rule: Use a fake claude executable that sleeps and sources a config file beside itself. Drive SIGSTOP, SIGKILL and cancel from the host, and keep funded runs for the one real digest chain. Set the harness time limit explicitly per drill.

verification.command: BAKERY_REAL_API=1 BAKERY_REAL_API_HARNESS=1 BAKERY_FS06_MODE=observe BAKERY_FS06_HARNESS=fake pnpm --dir apps/web test:ui run-observation-real-harness.spec --project=desktop-real-harness --workers=2
verification.requirement: Record the drill used, the observed worker and attempt states, and the restore result.

learning.boundary: Applies to ephemeral per-worktree stacks only; never drill the shared bakery-main stack.
